study_identification_part.si_4_title: Regional, circuit and network heterogeneity of brain abnormalities in psychiatric disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR) normative models fitted separately in each region.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We then trained a normative model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression 29 (HBR), fitted separately in each region, in a training set comprising 1,196 HCs (55.02% male; Fig. 2a; HC train ) to establish a normative GMV range

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional gray matter volume (GMV) estimates from T1-weighted VBM; aggregated into 1,032 brain areas.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We used an established pipeline to obtain voxel-wise estimates of GMV in each participant 25,26 (Methods), which we aggregated into regional estimates for 1,032 brain areas 27,28 (1,000 cortical and 32 subcortical regions; Fig. 2a).

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative GMV range modeled as a function of age, sex, and scan site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: to establish a normative GMV range given an individual's age, sex and scan site
